title: Kashmiri Samawar
description: Traditional hand-carved copper Samawar used for brewing authentic Kashmiri Kahwa. Featuring intricate floral engravings and a classic tinned inner lining for safety and durability.
extraInfo: Best for home decor and traditional tea serving.

title: Papier Mache Jewelry Box
description: Exquisite hand-painted Papier Mache box with 'Gul-e-Wilayat' motifs. Made using recycled paper pulp and organic colors by master artisans.
extraInfo: Perfect for storing small jewelry and trinkets.

title: Walnut Wood Bowl
description: Crafted from a single piece of seasoned Walnut wood. This bowl features a beautiful natural grain and deep brown hue, characteristic of authentic Kashmiri woodcraft.
extraInfo: Food safe; polished with natural beeswax.

title: Pashmina Shawl - Hand Embroidered
description: Luxuriously soft and warm Pashmina shawl featuring Sozni hand-embroidery. A masterpiece of patience and skill, taking months to complete by hand.
extraInfo: Dry clean only. Keeps you warm in sub-zero temperatures.

title: Crewel Embroidered Cushion Cover
description: Hand-embroidered wool yarn on heavy cotton canvas. Features traditional floral chain-stitch patterns that add a vibrant touch to any living room.
extraInfo: Zipper closure at the back. Size 16x16 inches.

title: Tweed Jacket - Handwoven
description: Handwoven wool tweed jacket. Merges traditional warmth with contemporary style. Breathable, durable, and naturally water-resistant.
extraInfo: Available in various sizes and natural earth tones.

title: Copper Serving Platter
description: Classic hammered copper platter with a silver-tin coating on the surface. Ideal for serving traditional meals or as a decorative wall piece.
extraInfo: Authentic 'Naqashi' work around the edges.

title: Willow Wicker Basket
description: Sturdy and elegant basket woven from the finest willow twigs. Perfect for picnics, storage, or as a sustainable gift hamper base.
extraInfo: Locally known as 'Keani' craft.

title: Kani Weave Scarf
description: Woven on a traditional loom using small wooden needles called 'Kani'. This scarf features a complex interlocking pattern of colors.
extraInfo: Inspired by the designs of the Mughal era.

title: Terracotta Flower Pot
description: Hand-thrown clay pot with traditional engravings. Breathable material that promotes healthy plant growth and adds an earthy vibe to your garden.

title: Namda Felted Rug
